notes.title: Age of Barbarians 2 Update#1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23483734/6ae6d4077c00fcb199922a7c281adcaa25981d8b.jpg[/img]
Hey Barbarians, we're excited to share with you some news about the Age of Barbarians II.
First of all, we can officially declare that Age of Barbarians 2 will be our next game!
So prepare yourselves to be bombarded with tons of news, very shortly.
Age of Barbarians 2 will be an action-adventure RPG, wholly realized in high-resolution 2d graphics.
Unlike its predecessor, it will be realized in an isometric perspective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23483734/30d778c0ee94e35914798c59938d0a300991e7d7.jpg[/img]
The game will be huge, ambient in an intense and refined fantasy world, freely explorable.
In addition to the epic main story, the game will contain a vast number of side quests, dungeons, towns and places to explores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23483734/853b7d61e4165480ef224e6e9f4bf58445545cc7.jpg[/img]
Lastly, but not least, we can confirm that Rahaan & Sheyna will be newly playable in the game!
Stay tuned!

Hey Barbarians, the update 1.7.4 is ready: 
We'll do our best to fix all the issues reported and update the game on regular basis. Thank you! 

[b]Age of Barbarian Ex 1.7.4[/b]

- The virtual memory, raised from 2GB to 4GB.
- Indicators on/off, was not saved correctly, fixed.
- If player dodge a high blow, sometime enemy animation change like if the player was hit, fixed.
- Game engine: there was some memory issue in some PC configuration, game should be lighter now.
- Area 1-1: there was a spike trap that doesn't work correctly, fixed. 
- Apeman: when player execute him, the blood was in a wrong layer, fixed.
- Kar-Azza 3-1/3-2: Torch and/or flame sometime was in a wrong layer, fixed.
- Sabretooth tiger: Sometimes when player was in close combat another sabretooth appear, fixed.
- Crocodile: Sometimes his attack could freeze the player, fixed.
- Chuth 4-3B: A saw trap was too low to be avoided by crouching, fixed.
- Chuth: Because if an old script, when the barbarian make a flying attack he was stopped in air, fixed.
- Beast rider: After continue, enemies doesn't spawn, fixed.
- Beast rider Wyverns: when the camera rise up, there was a scrolling issue, fixed.
- The Wyvern’s peaks, 6-3B: When palyuer was grabbed by a tentacle, some animations glitch, fixed.
- Necron's Fortress: Wrong saving at the beginning of the leve, fixed.
- Necron's Fortress 7-3: Scrolling issue, fixed.
- Necron's Fortress 7-3: Roof trap and player control issue, fixed.
- Necron's Fortress 7-3: Sometimes when player hanging from a platform, scream like he was falling, fixed.
- Necron's Fortress 7-4: Hud glitch, fixed.
- Skeleton's shadows glitch, fixed.
- Skeleton: Sometimes when thay are hit, there was a kind of swap position glitch, fixed.
- Sometimes enemies spawn from nowhere, fixed.


[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Zoom script improved.
- Dark Warrior: IA improved.
- Death Dealer: IA improved.
- Skeleton: IA improved.
